title.rw: Ubumenyi mu itangazamakuru no mu makuru
Imihindagurikire y'ikirere, iteganyagihe n'ubushobozi bw'abaturage bwo guhangana n'ingaruka

description.en: Understand the difference between weather and climate and how communities prepare for changing risks.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa itandukaniro ry'ikirere cya buri munsi n'imiterere y'ikirere y'igihe kirekire n'uko abaturage bitegura ibyago bihinduka.

definition.en: Weather describes short-term atmospheric conditions, while climate describes patterns and averages of weather over longer periods.
definition.rw: Iteganyagihe risobanura uko ikirere kimeze mu gihe gito, mu gihe imiterere y'ikirere isobanura uko ikirere cyagiye kimeze n'impuzandengo yacyo mu gihe kirekire.

en: Distinguish weather from climate.
Give one example of adaptation and one of resilience.
rw: Tandukanya iteganyagihe n'imiterere y'ikirere.
Tanga urugero rumwe rwo kumenyera imihindagurikire y'ikirere n'urwo guhangana n'ingaruka.

en: Weather can change from hour to hour or day to day. Climate is studied using long records and patterns, including temperature, rainfall, wind and seasonal changes. One cold day does not disprove long-term warming, just as one hot day does not prove it.

Climate change can affect water availability, farming, ecosystems, health and infrastructure. The effects differ by place and depend on exposure, sensitivity and the resources available to prepare and respond.

Adaptation means adjusting decisions and systems to reduce harm from actual or expected climate impacts. Examples include protecting wetlands, improving drainage where appropriate, using reliable weather information and planning for heat or heavy rainfall.

Resilience is the ability of people and systems to prepare for, cope with and recover from difficult conditions. It can be strengthened through reliable information, community cooperation, well-maintained services and plans that include people who may need extra support.

Climate information is most useful when it is local, timely and understood. Check trusted meteorological and public safety sources, and follow official advice during severe weather. Avoid sharing unverified warnings that may cause confusion.
rw: Iteganyagihe rishobora guhinduka kuva ku isaha imwe rijya ku yindi cyangwa umunsi ku wundi. Imiterere y'ikirere isuzumwa hifashishijwe amakuru y'igihe kirekire, harimo ubushyuhe, imvura, umuyaga n'impinduka z'ibihe. Umunsi umwe ukonje ntuhakana izamuka ry'ubushyuhe ry'igihe kirekire, nk'uko umunsi umwe ushyushye na wo utabihamya.

Imihindagurikire y'ikirere ishobora kugira ingaruka ku mazi aboneka, ubuhinzi, urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima, ubuzima n'ibikorwa remezo. Ingaruka ziratandukana bitewe n'ahantu, ibyago bihari, uko abaturage babangamirwa n'ubushobozi bwo kwitegura no kubyitwaramo.

Kumenyera imihindagurikire y'ikirere ni uguhindura ibyemezo n'imikorere kugira ngo hagabanuke ingaruka zayo zigaragara cyangwa ziteganyijwe. Ingero zirimo kurinda ibishanga, kunoza uburyo amazi atemba aho bikwiye, gukoresha amakuru y'iteganyagihe yizewe no gutegura uko abantu bazitwara mu bushyuhe cyangwa imvura nyinshi.

Ubushobozi bwo guhangana n'ingaruka ni ubushobozi bw'abantu n'ibikorwa remezo bwo kwitegura, guhangana n'ibihe bikomeye no kongera kwisuganya. Bwakongerwa n'amakuru yizewe, ubufatanye bw'abaturage, serivisi zibungabunzwe neza n'imigambi yita ku bantu bashobora gukenera ubufasha bwiyongereye.

Amakuru y'ikirere agira akamaro cyane iyo ajyanye n'ahantu, agezweho kandi asobanutse. Reba amasoko yizewe y'iteganyagihe n'umutekano rusange, kandi ukurikize amabwiriza y'inzego zibishinzwe mu bihe bibi. Irinde gusangiza abandi imiburo itagenzuwe ishobora guteza urujijo.

en: Weather is short-term; climate is a long-term pattern.
Climate impacts differ across communities.
Adaptation reduces exposure and vulnerability.
Use trusted local forecasts and official alerts.
rw: Iteganyagihe ni iry'igihe gito; imiterere y'ikirere ni iy'igihe kirekire.
Ingaruka z'imihindagurikire y'ikirere zirahinduka bitewe n'abaturage n'ahantu.
Kumenyera ikirere bigabanya ibyago no kuba abantu bahura n'ingaruka.
Koresha iteganyagihe ryo mu karere n'imiburo y'inzego zizewe.

real_world_activity.en: Prepared communities use reliable information and cooperate before, during and after difficult weather.
real_world_activity.rw: Abaturage biteguye neza bakoresha amakuru yizewe kandi bagafatanya mbere, mu gihe na nyuma y'ikirere gikomeye.

en: Why should a climate claim use long-term evidence?
Where should people check urgent weather warnings?
rw: Kuki ikivugwa ku mihindagurikire y'ikirere kigomba gushingira ku bimenyetso by'igihe kirekire?
Abantu bakwiye kugenzura he imiburo yihutirwa y'ikirere?

conclusion.en: Ask your household or class to identify one weather-related risk in the area and one safe, realistic preparation step based on official guidance.
conclusion.rw: Saba abo mu rugo cyangwa abo mwigana kugaragaza icyago kimwe kijyanye n'ikirere gishobora kuboneka aho mutuye n'intambwe imwe itekanye kandi ishoboka yo kwitegura ishingiye ku mabwiriza yemewe.

title.en: Fresh Water, Water Quality and Conservation
title.rw: Amazi meza, ubwiza bwayo no kuyabungabunga

description.en: Explore where fresh water is found, why water quality matters and how communities can conserve it.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa aho amazi meza aboneka, impamvu ubwiza bwayo ari ingenzi n'uko abaturage bayabungabunga.

definition.en: Fresh water is water with low concentrations of dissolved salts that can support people, agriculture and ecosystems when it is safe and available.
definition.rw: Amazi meza ni amazi arimo umunyu ushongeshejwe muke ashobora gufasha abantu, ubuhinzi n'urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima iyo aboneka kandi afite umutekano.

en: Name three places where fresh water is stored.
Why can clear water still be unsafe?
rw: Vuga ahantu hatatu amazi meza abikwa.
Kuki amazi asa neza ashobora kuba atari meza kunyobwa?

en: Most of Earth's water is salty ocean water. Fresh water is stored in glaciers and ice, underground aquifers, lakes, rivers, wetlands, soil and the atmosphere. Only a portion is easily accessible for everyday human use.

The water cycle moves water through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, runoff and plant transpiration. These processes connect the atmosphere, land, rivers, lakes and underground water stores.

Water quality can be affected by sewage, chemicals, waste, soil erosion and harmful microorganisms. Clear-looking water is not necessarily safe to drink. Use water treatment and safety advice from qualified local health authorities.

Protecting water sources includes keeping waste and chemicals away from streams, maintaining sanitation, protecting wetlands and vegetation, and preventing soil from washing into rivers. Communities and institutions share responsibility for safe water systems.

Conservation means using water thoughtfully and reducing avoidable waste. Repairing leaks through qualified help, collecting rainwater where safe and permitted, and using only the water needed for household tasks can help. Do not compromise handwashing or safe drinking-water needs to save water.
rw: Amazi menshi yo ku isi ni amazi y'inyanja arimo umunyu. Amazi meza abikwa mu rubura, mu butaka bwimbitse burimo amazi, mu biyaga, imigezi, ibishanga, ubutaka no mu kirere. Amazi make gusa ni yo ashobora kuboneka byoroshye mu buzima bwa buri munsi.

Uruziga rw'amazi ruyanyuza mu guhinduka umwuka, kwirema kw'ibicu, kugwa kw'imvura, kwinjira mu butaka, gutemba ku buso bw'ubutaka no gusohoka mu bimera. Ibi bihuza ikirere, ubutaka, imigezi, ibiyaga n'amazi abitswe munsi y'ubutaka.

Ubwiza bw'amazi bushobora kwangizwa n'imyanda yo mu bwiherero, imiti, imyanda isanzwe, isuri n'udukoko dutera indwara. Amazi asa neza si ko buri gihe aba meza kunyobwa. Koresha uburyo bwo kuyatunganya n'inama z'inzego z'ubuzima zibifitiye ubumenyi.

Kurinda amasoko y'amazi birimo kutajugunya imyanda n'imiti hafi y'imigezi, kubungabunga isuku, kurinda ibishanga n'ibimera no gukumira isuri ijyana ubutaka mu migezi. Abaturage n'inzego zitandukanye basangiye inshingano zo kugira amazi meza.

Kubungabunga amazi ni ukuyakoresha neza no kugabanya ayapfa ubusa. Gusana imiyoboro itemba hifashishijwe ababifitiye ubumenyi, gukusanya amazi y'imvura aho bitekanye kandi byemewe, no gukoresha amazi akenewe gusa mu mirimo yo mu rugo birafasha. Ntukagabanye gukaraba intoki cyangwa amazi meza yo kunywa mu rwego rwo kuzigama.

en: Fresh water is limited and unevenly distributed.
The water cycle links land, air and living systems.
Clear water is not automatically safe to drink.
Protect water sources and avoid unnecessary waste.
rw: Amazi meza ni make kandi ntiyigabanyije kimwe ku isi.
Uruziga rw'amazi ruhuza ubutaka, ikirere n'ibinyabuzima.
Amazi asa neza si ko buri gihe aba meza kunyobwa.
Rinda amasoko y'amazi kandi wirinde kuyapfusha ubusa.

real_world_activity.en: Water security depends on science, safe services, responsible use and protection of natural ecosystems.
real_world_activity.rw: Kugira amazi ahagije kandi meza bishingira ku bumenyi, serivisi zitekanye, kuyakoresha neza no kurinda urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima.

en: How does vegetation help protect water sources?
What is one way to reduce water waste without reducing hygiene?
rw: Ibimera bifasha bite kurinda amasoko y'amazi?
Ni ubuhe buryo bumwe bwo kugabanya amazi apfa ubusa utagabanyije isuku?

title.en: Rwanda's Geography, Landscapes and Human Activity
title.rw: Imiterere y'u Rwanda, ubutaka n'ibikorwa by'abaturage

description.en: Connect physical geography with settlement, transport, farming, water and environmental care in Rwanda.
description.rw: Huza imiterere y'ubutaka n'imiturire, ubwikorezi, ubuhinzi, amazi no kubungabunga ibidukikije mu Rwanda.

definition.en: Geography studies places, physical environments, people and the relationships between them.
definition.rw: Ubumenyi bw'isi busuzuma ahantu, imiterere y'ibidukikije, abantu n'isano iri hagati yabyo.

en: Explain one way elevation affects human activity.
What information makes a map easier to interpret?
rw: Sobanura uburyo bumwe uburebure bw'ahantu bugira ingaruka ku bikorwa by'abantu.
Ni ayahe makuru atuma gusoma ikarita byoroha?

en: Rwanda is a landlocked country in East-Central Africa. Its landscape includes highlands, hills, valleys, lakes and areas of volcanic mountains in the west. Elevation and terrain influence local temperature, rainfall, farming and transport.

The country's drainage is connected to two major river-basin systems: the Nile basin and the Congo basin. Lakes, wetlands and rivers support communities, biodiversity, fishing, agriculture and other livelihoods, but they need protection from pollution and poorly managed land use.

Population and economic activities are not spread evenly. Towns often develop around transport routes, services, markets and institutions. Rural settlement patterns are influenced by land, water, soil, slope and access to roads and public services.

Maps help people understand location, direction, distance and relationships between places. A map should include a title, legend, scale and orientation where appropriate. Digital maps can be useful, but their information may be incomplete or outdated.

Geography is practical: understanding slopes can help explain erosion; knowing drainage patterns can help communities plan for heavy rainfall; and understanding land use can support decisions that protect water, soil and habitats.
rw: U Rwanda ni igihugu kitagira inkombe z'inyanja giherereye mu burasirazuba bwo hagati bwa Afurika. Imiterere yacyo irimo imisozi miremire, udusozi, ibibaya, ibiyaga n'udusozi tw'ibirunga mu burengerazuba. Uburebure bw'ahantu n'imiterere y'ubutaka bigira ingaruka ku bushyuhe, imvura, ubuhinzi n'ubwikorezi.

Amazi y'imigezi yo mu Rwanda ajya mu byogogo bibiri bikuru: icy'uruzi rwa Nil n'icy'uruzi rwa Kongo. Ibiyaga, ibishanga n'imigezi bifasha abaturage, urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima, uburobyi, ubuhinzi n'ibindi bitunga abantu, ariko bigomba kurindwa umwanda n'imikoreshereze mibi y'ubutaka.

Abaturage n'ibikorwa by'ubukungu ntibikwirakwiye kimwe. Imijyi ikunda gukura hafi y'imihanda, serivisi, amasoko n'inzego z'ubuyobozi. Imiturire yo mu cyaro iterwa n'ubutaka, amazi, ubwiza bw'ubutaka, ubuhaname n'uko abantu bagera ku mihanda na serivisi rusange.

Ikarita ifasha gusobanukirwa aho ahantu riherereye, icyerekezo, intera n'isano iri hagati y'ahantu. Ikarita ikwiye kugira umutwe, ibisobanuro by'ibimenyetso, igipimo n'icyerekezo igihe bikenewe. Ikarita zo kuri telefoni zirafasha, ariko amakuru yazo ashobora kuba atuzuye cyangwa ataravugururwa.

Ubumenyi bw'isi bufite akamaro mu buzima: gusobanukirwa ahantu hahanamye bifasha gusobanura isuri; kumenya aho amazi atembera bifasha gutegura imvura nyinshi; naho gusobanukirwa imikoreshereze y'ubutaka bigafasha kurinda amazi, ubutaka n'aho ibinyabuzima bituye.

en: Rwanda's terrain influences climate, farming and transport.
Water basins connect communities and ecosystems.
Maps need clear symbols, scale and orientation.
Land-use choices affect soil, water and habitats.
rw: Imiterere y'ubutaka bw'u Rwanda igira ingaruka ku kirere, ubuhinzi n'ubwikorezi.
Ibyogogo by'amazi bihuza abaturage n'urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima.
Ikarita ikenera ibimenyetso bisobanutse, igipimo n'icyerekezo.
Imikoreshereze y'ubutaka igira ingaruka ku butaka, amazi n'aho ibinyabuzima bituye.

real_world_activity.en: Geography helps communities make better decisions because places, people and natural systems are connected.
real_world_activity.rw: Ubumenyi bw'isi bufasha abaturage gufata ibyemezo byiza kuko ahantu, abantu n'ibidukikije bifitanye isano.

en: Why are wetlands important to communities?
How can a map help plan a safe journey?
rw: Kuki ibishanga ari ingenzi ku baturage?
Ikarita yafasha ite gutegura urugendo rufite umutekano?

title.en: Everyday Money Skills: Needs, Wants and Planning
title.rw: Ubumenyi bw'amafaranga: ibikenewe, ibyifuzo no guteganya

description.en: Learn basic financial decision-making through needs, wants, saving and simple budgets.
description.rw: Menya gufata ibyemezo by'ibanze ku mafaranga ukoresheje ibikenewe, ibyifuzo, kuzigama na bije yoroshye.

definition.en: Financial literacy is the ability to understand basic money concepts and use them to make informed everyday decisions.
definition.rw: Ubumenyi mu micungire y'amafaranga ni ubushobozi bwo gusobanukirwa ibitekerezo by'ibanze by'amafaranga no kubikoresha mu gufata ibyemezo bya buri munsi bishingiye ku makuru.

en: Explain the difference between a need and a want.
What information should be compared before a purchase?
rw: Sobanura itandukaniro riri hagati y'igikenewe n'icyifuzo.
Ni ayahe makuru agomba kugereranywa mbere yo kugura?

en: A need is something important for health, safety or daily living, while a want is something a person would like but can often manage without. The difference can depend on circumstances: reliable transport may be essential for one person and optional for another.

A budget is a plan for how money will be received and used over a period. A simple budget lists expected income, essential costs, optional spending and an amount to save if possible. A budget is a guide that can be adjusted when circumstances change.

Saving means setting aside part of available money for a future purpose or unexpected cost. Saving goals should be realistic and should not replace essential needs such as food, safe housing, education or healthcare.

Before buying something, compare the total cost, quality, usefulness and whether the seller is trustworthy. Be careful with pressure to buy immediately, unrealistic promises of quick profit or requests to send money to claim a prize.

Financial decisions should be age-appropriate. Young people can practise planning with small, supervised examples and ask a trusted adult before making online payments, sharing financial details or agreeing to contracts.
rw: Igikenewe ni ikintu cy'ingenzi ku buzima, umutekano cyangwa imibereho ya buri munsi, mu gihe icyifuzo ari ikintu umuntu yakwifuza ariko ashobora kubaho atagifite. Itandukaniro rishobora guterwa n'imiterere: ubwikorezi bwizewe bushobora kuba ngombwa ku muntu umwe ariko bukaba atari ngombwa ku wundi.

Bije ni umugambi w'uko amafaranga azaboneka n'uko azakoreshwa mu gihe runaka. Bije yoroshye igaragaza amafaranga ateganyijwe kwinjira, ibiciro by'ibikenewe, amafaranga y'ibindi byifuzo n'ayo kuzigama igihe bishoboka. Bije ni umurongo ngenderwaho ushobora guhindurwa uko ibintu bihinduka.

Kuzigama ni ukubika igice cy'amafaranga ahari kugira ngo azakoreshwe mu gihe kizaza cyangwa mu kibazo umuntu atari yiteze. Intego yo kuzigama ikwiye kuba ishoboka kandi ntisimbure ibikenewe nk'ibiryo, aho kuba hatekanye, uburezi cyangwa ubuvuzi.

Mbere yo kugura ikintu, gereranya igiciro cyose, ubwiza, akamaro n'uko umucuruzi yizewe. Witondere igitutu cyo kugura ako kanya, amasezerano adashoboka y'inyungu yihuse cyangwa umuntu ugusaba kohereza amafaranga kugira ngo uhabwe igihembo.

Ibyemezo by'amafaranga bigomba kuba bijyanye n'imyaka y'umuntu. Abakiri bato bashobora kwimenyereza guteganya bakoresheje ingero nto zigenzurwa, kandi bakabaza umuntu mukuru bizeye mbere yo kwishyura kuri murandasi, gutanga amakuru y'imari cyangwa kwemera amasezerano.

en: Separate essential needs from optional wants.
A budget is a plan, not a guarantee.
Set realistic saving goals without neglecting essentials.
Be cautious of pressure, prize and quick-profit scams.
rw: Tandukanya ibikenewe n'ibyifuzo bidakenewe.
Bije ni umugambi, si isezerano ko byose bizagenda uko biteganyijwe.
Shyiraho intego zifatika zo kuzigama utirengagije ibikenewe.
Witondere uburiganya bukoresha igitutu, ibihembo cyangwa inyungu zihuse.

real_world_activity.en: Good money habits begin with clear priorities, realistic plans and careful decisions.
real_world_activity.rw: Ingeso nziza zo gukoresha amafaranga zitangirira ku gushyira imbere ibikenewe, imigambi ishoboka no gufata ibyemezo witonze.

en: Why should a budget include a small allowance for unexpected costs?
Why should young people ask a trusted adult before online payments?
rw: Kuki bije ikwiye kugira amafaranga make y'ibintu bitunguranye?
Kuki abakiri bato bagomba kubaza umuntu mukuru bizeye mbere yo kwishyura kuri murandasi?

conclusion.en: Use a pretend monthly amount to create a practice budget with categories for essentials, optional spending and savings. Do not share real family financial details.
conclusion.rw: Koresha amafaranga y'igereranya y'ukwezi ukore bije y'imyitozo igaragaza ibikenewe, ibindi byifuzo no kuzigama. Ntugasangize abandi amakuru nyakuri y'amafaranga y'umuryango wawe.
